raw_response: DESCRIPTION: This figure is a nested donut chart (also called a sunburst or concentric pie chart) consisting of two concentric rings that represent two different ambiguity metrics. The outer ring represents "Ambiguity Std" and is divided into four slices: "Std: 0.0" shown in dark navy at approximately 49.0%, "Std: 0.47" in a dark teal-blue at 47.7%, "Std: 0.82" in a medium dark blue-green at 7.0% (a narrow slice at the top), and "Std: 0.94" in a medium blue at 5.0% (another narrow slice). The inner ring represents "Max Ambiguity" and is divided into three slices: "Max: 1" in a medium-light cyan-blue at 38.0%, "Max: 2" in a lighter sky blue at 39.0%, and "Max: 3" in a very pale light blue at 14.2%. Percentage labels are displayed directly on or adjacent to each slice. Two separate legends are positioned to the right of the chart, one for each ring, clearly distinguishing the outer "Ambiguity Std" categories from the inner "Max Ambiguity" categories using color-coded squares. In the outer ring, the two largest slices (Std: 0.0 and Std: 0.47) dominate, together accounting for approximately 96.7% of the distribution, while in the inner ring, the Max: 1 and Max: 2 categories are roughly equal in size and together comprise about 77% of the total.
